title: AXIAL_DISTRIBUTION_AND_REFLECTION_SYMMETRY_BC_BATCH_NO_Y
purpose: Generate 24 axial-location, axial-spread and reflection-asymmetry candidates from already hash-verified SLICE-004 slice/overlay pixel profiles without creating any image, mask, mesh or slice.

candidate_schema.RAW-X041: normalized axial weighted centroid/spread for slice material-area and component-count profiles
candidate_schema.RAW-X042: normalized axial weighted centroid/spread for red/blue/purple/union overlay count profiles
candidate_schema.RAW-X043: normalized axial weighted centroid/spread for red/blue/purple phase-fraction profiles
candidate_schema.RAW-X044: normalized reflection asymmetry for two slice and four overlay count profiles
candidate_schema.position_grid: uniform normalized coordinates from 0 to 1 inclusive over the frozen ordered rows
candidate_schema.reflection_formula: mean(abs(profile - reversed(profile))) / mean(abs(profile)); fail if denominator is not positive
